title: CPU parallelism determinism property test suite
description:
## Goal

Property-test harness asserting byte-identity of the four
deterministic columns across worker counts {1, 2, 4, 8, 24} for
at least three (rate, modulation) configurations.

## Context

Task under story `bcf7776d` (CPU foundation for gf2-sim
pipeline) within epic `gf2-sim` (`f9717e7e`). Placeholder body —
project-lead expands during claim.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] Project-lead expands this section with verifiable
  acceptance conditions consistent with the parent story's
  deliverables and the epic's architecture contract.
- [hard] Property test asserts byte-identity for `fer` /
  `frames` / `errors` / `mean_iters` across worker counts
  {1, 2, 4, 8, 24} for ≥3 (rate, modulation) configurations
  (DVB-T2 BICM canonical); BER excluded per status-quo contract.

## Non-goals

See epic `f9717e7e` non-goals; GPU determinism is covered by
the GPU stages story.
